credit_metrics.text: EBITDA declined by {{ebitda.change@FY2025}} to {{ebitda@FY2025}} and operating profit by {{operating_profit.change@FY2025}} to {{operating_profit@FY2025}}, with write-offs on the abandoned third runway project and personnel expenses rising under collective wage agreements weighing on the result.
Total debt was stable at {{total_debt@FY2025}}, so gross leverage held at {{gross_leverage@FY2025}}, a change of {{gross_leverage.change@FY2025}}.
FFO fell by {{ffo.change@FY2025}} to {{ffo@FY2025}}, and free cash flow dropped by {{fcf.change@FY2025}} to {{fcf@FY2025}} as capital spending absorbed more of the cash generated.
Capex intensity increased by {{capex_intensity.change@FY2025}} to {{capex_intensity@FY2025}}, against {{capex_intensity@FY2024}} in FY2024.

liquidity_funding.text: The fact base does not carry cash and cash-like investments or undrawn committed facilities for FY2025, so the liquidity buffer cannot be sized against revenue.
With total debt of {{total_debt@FY2025}} against EBITDA of {{ebitda@FY2025}}, refinancing needs are small relative to annual earnings.
Free cash flow of {{fcf@FY2025}} was generated after capex intensity of {{capex_intensity@FY2025}}, leaving less headroom than the {{fcf@FY2024}} of FY2024.

watch_items.text: Cash generation: free cash flow fell by {{fcf.change@FY2025}} to {{fcf@FY2025}} and FFO by {{ffo.change@FY2025}} to {{ffo@FY2025}}, so the buffer against the investment programme has narrowed.
Investment: capex intensity rose by {{capex_intensity.change@FY2025}} to {{capex_intensity@FY2025}}, above the peer median of {{capex_intensity.peer_median@FY2025}}.

Margins: the EBITDA margin fell by {{ebitda_margin.change@FY2025}} to {{ebitda_margin@FY2025}}, with write-offs on the abandoned third runway project and personnel expenses rising under collective wage agreements in the base.
